description: Source code for a wizard interface in OpenERP/Odoo, handling system setup and configuration through forms and methods.

classes.name: wizard_base_setup
classes.description: Wizard interface class for system setup, including methods for retrieving profiles, company info, updating configuration, and navigation.

methods.name: _get_profiles
methods.description: Retrieve available module profiles for setup.

methods.name: _get_all
methods.description: Retrieve list of records for a given model.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Update company and profile configuration based on form data.

methods.name: _menu
methods.description: Set user menu actions to the main menu.

methods.name: _next
methods.description: Determine next step in setup flow.

methods.name: _previous
methods.description: Determine previous step in setup flow.
